description: This PHP class defines a validation rule for timezone offsets within the OrangeHRM system, specifically ensuring the offset is within the valid range (-12.00 to 14.00). It extends an abstract rule class and provides constants for the westernmost and easternmost timezone offsets.

classes.name: TimezoneOffset
classes.description: A validation rule class for checking if a timezone offset is within the valid range in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the provided timezone offset input is a number within the allowed range (-12.00 to 14.00).
